# Example Sigma rules (Sigma Zero)

YAML rules in `examples/` are **illustrations** for [`sdx-cli`](../../README.md#sigma-rules-sigma-zero) and the library’s [`detection::sigma`](../../src/detection/sigma/) conversion.

- Point `--rules-dir` at this directory (or at `examples/` only) to load them.
- Adjust `level`, patterns, and `tags` for your environment; some demos are intentionally broad.

Rule format follows [Sigma](https://github.com/SigmaHQ/sigma) conventions as supported by [sigma-zero](https://github.com/ping2A/sigmazero).
